Financial distress in Hong Kong’s commercial property market has moderated but not been completely eliminated, analysts say, with highly leveraged asset owners still expected to find refinancing their loans a challenge.
The city’s office and retail property segments have been mired in a multi-year slump, with new supply outstripping demand in recent years as
